steps.en: Install the Go binary and register it as a background daemon
steps.zh: 装上 Go 单二进制，把它注册成后台守护进程

steps.en: A control-plane server starts on 127.0.0.1:9867 with a bearer token and a default headless Chrome
steps.zh: 起一个带令牌的控制面服务和默认无头 Chrome

steps.en: Drop the shipped skill into your agent's skills directory
steps.zh: 把随包附带的技能装进 agent 的技能目录

steps.en: Navigate and snapshot in one call
steps.zh: 一次调用完成导航加快照

steps.en: Drives Chrome over CDP and returns a text snapshot — each interactive element tagged with a ref
steps.zh: 通过 CDP 驱动 Chrome，返回文本快照——每个可交互元素带一个引用

steps.en: Act on a ref instead of a selector
steps.zh: 对着引用动手，而不是对着选择器

steps.en: Profiles keep cookies and storage on disk, so a logged-in session survives restarts
steps.zh: 配置档把 cookie 和存储留在磁盘上，登录态跨重启存活

value.en: A browser step costs one round trip of text, not a screenshot to read or a selector to maintain — and the browser stays warm between steps
value.zh: 每一步浏览器操作只是一次文本往返——不用读截图，不用维护选择器，浏览器还一直热着

sources: README.md “What is PinchTab?” / “Primary Usage” (curl install starts the control-plane server and a default headless Chrome; pinchtab daemon install installs and starts the daemon; point your agent at http://localhost:9867)
README.md “Agent skill” (npm package ships the pinchtab agent skill; pinchtab skill status / pinchtab skill update install or refresh it into ~/.claude/skills and peers)
README.md “Use It” and “Examples” (pinchtab nav https://pinchtab.com --snap; pinchtab snap -i; pinchtab click e5; pinchtab fill e3 "user@pinchtab.com")
README.md “Key Features” (accessibility-first element refs — the same e5 survives a change of filter/selector/depth and expires only on navigation; multi-instance with isolated profiles)
docs/guides/security.md (server.bind = 127.0.0.1, server.token bearer auth, capability gates off by default, IDPI enabled by default)
docs/core-concepts.md referenced from README (Server manages profiles/instances/routing; Profile = cookies/history/local storage persisted across restarts; Bridge = single-instance runtime)
